Quiet mode switches itself on while Plex, Jellyfin or Emby is playing something, and it has a card of its own under Settings, Automation.

## ✨ Added

- **Quiet mode during playback.** Add your media server in the Quiet mode card under Settings, Automation, and quiet mode switches itself on while something plays there and off again about half a minute after the last stream ends. KnightLoader asks Plex, Jellyfin and Emby every ten seconds. A stream paused for more than half an hour stops counting, and streams at home can be left out.
- **Unpacking waits for the film.** While a stream counts, archives that finish downloading wait in the list as "Waiting for playback to end" and are unpacked once it is over. The same card switches this off.
- **An upload limit for quiet mode.** Torrents upload at most this much while quiet mode is on. That is the number that matters when your media server streams to someone away from home.
- **Off for this stream.** The card shows what is playing and whether it counts. Off for this stream brings the usual limits back until that stream ends.

## 🎨 Design

- **Quiet mode has a card on the Automation page** with its speed limit, the number of downloads at once and the torrent upload limit. Media servers are added from tiles, the way a VPN is, and the timetable offers Quiet mode as an action.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A changed quiet limit applies at once.** A new quiet mode figure had no effect while the mode was already on, until it was switched off and on again.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface.
